# Portability substrates

Five small synthetic repositories represent a Python tool, React/TypeScript UI, backend API, infrastructure code and a documentation-only project. They test governance adoption and preservation across distinct stacks and risk profiles. They are not complete application build/test distributions; optional toolchains are not installed or executed by adoption. Instructions/test commands/invariants remain project-owned and byte-identical. No network, live infrastructure or real user data is required.
